description: A Template describes a scaffolding task for use with the Scaffolder. It describes the required parameters as well as a series of steps that will be taken to execute the scaffolding task.

metadata.name: react-ssr-template
metadata.title: React SSR Template
metadata.description: Next.js application skeleton for creating isomorphic web applications.

type.description: The type of component created by the template. The software catalog accepts any type value, but an organization should take great care to establish a proper taxonomy for these. Tools including Backstage itself may read this field and behave differently depending on its value. For example, a website type component may present tooling in the Backstage interface that is specific to just websites.

owner.description: The user (or group) owner of the template

oneOf.description: The JSONSchema describing the inputs for the template.

backstage:permissions.description: Object used for authorizing the parameter

oneOf.description: A list of separate forms to collect parameters.

items.description: The JSONSchema describing the inputs for the template.

backstage:permissions.description: Object used for authorizing the parameter

steps.description: A list of steps to execute.

items.description: A description of the step to execute.

id.description: The ID of the step, which can be used to refer to its outputs.

name.description: The name of the step, which will be displayed in the UI during the scaffolding process.

action.description: The name of the action to execute.

input.description: A templated object describing the inputs to the action.

if.description: A templated condition that skips the step when evaluated to false. If the condition is true or not defined, the step is executed. The condition is true, if the input is not `false`, `undefined`, `null`, `""`, `0`, or `[]`.

backstage:permissions.description: Object used for authorizing the step

output.description: A templated object describing the outputs of the scaffolding task.

links.description: A list of external hyperlinks, typically pointing to resources created or updated by the template

url.description: A url in a standard uri format.

entityRef.description: An entity reference to an entity in the catalog.

title.description: A user friendly display name for the link.

icon.description: A key representing a visual icon to be displayed in the UI.

text.description: A list of Markdown text blobs, like output data from the template.

title.description: A user friendly display name for the text.

icon.description: A key representing a visual icon to be displayed in the UI.

content.description: The text blob to display in the UI, rendered as Markdown.

apiVersion.description: The version of specification format for this particular entity that this is written against.

kind.description: The high level entity type being described.

spec.description: The specification data describing the entity itself.

relations.description: The relations that this entity has with other entities.

metadata.description: Metadata fields common to all versions/kinds of entity.

uid.description: A globally unique ID for the entity. This field can not be set by the user at creation time, and the server will reject an attempt to do so. The field will be populated in read operations. The field can (optionally) be specified when performing update or delete operations, but the server is free to reject requests that do so in such a way that it breaks semantics.

etag.description: An opaque string that changes for each update operation to any part of the entity, including metadata. This field can not be set by the user at creation time, and the server will reject an attempt to do so. The field will be populated in read operations. The field can (optionally) be specified when performing update or delete operations, and the server will then reject the operation if it does not match the current stored value.

name.description: The name of the entity. Must be unique within the catalog at any given point in time, for any given namespace + kind pair.

namespace.description: The namespace that the entity belongs to.

title.description: A display name of the entity, to be presented in user interfaces instead of the name property, when available.

description.description: A short (typically relatively few words, on one line) description of the entity.

labels.description: Key/value pairs of identifying information attached to the entity.

annotations.description: Key/value pairs of non-identifying auxiliary information attached to the entity.

tags.description: A list of single-valued strings, to for example classify catalog entities in various ways.

links.description: A list of external hyperlinks related to the entity. Links can provide additional contextual information that may be located outside of Backstage itself. For example, an admin dashboard or external CMS page.

url.description: A url in a standard uri format.

title.description: A user friendly display name for the link.

icon.description: A key representing a visual icon to be displayed in the UI.

type.description: An optional value to categorize links into specific groups.

reference.description: A reference by name to another entity.

kind.description: The kind field of the entity.

namespace.description: The metadata.namespace field of the entity.

name.description: The metadata.name field of the entity.

relation.description: A directed relation from one entity to another.

targetRef.description: The entity ref of the target of this relation.

status.description: The current status of the entity, as claimed by various sources.

statusItem.description: A specific status item on a well known format.

level.description: The status level / severity of the status item.

message.description: A brief message describing the status, intended for human consumption.

error.description: An optional serialized error object related to the status.

name.description: The type name of the error

code.description: An error code associated with the error
